notes: BloxIMD (BLOX) is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its argument-free constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 tokens once to msg.sender, the launch factory. Transfers have no tax or burn. The token has no owner, administrative controls, subsequent minting, or upgrade mechanism. There are no application contracts or initialization calls. The accepted token logo is assets/blox-logo.jpg, with source provenance recorded in assets/provenance.json. The pool pairs with native ETH at a 1.25% fee and tick spacing 60. pool.initialPrice is provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply.
